source: ONS-produced UK CPI all-items annual rate D7G7 and services annual rate D7NN, MM23. Archive the original first published measurement of each reference month independently in both series, with the dated native version, predecessor catalogue timestamp and ONS published release convention/calendar. Exclude unconfirmed original vintages, conflicting release clocks, nonconsecutive months, or corrections without the first vintage. A supersession timestamp belongs to the replaced object and is not its original release clock. No market-consensus forecast is imputed.
dates: Every first verified monthly release on a full US trading day from 2016-01-01 until the first production edition 2026-11-03T06:28:30.460Z. Both current first-vintage annual rates and those of the immediately preceding original reference month must be known before 07:48 America/New_York on the release day. No shifting skipped releases to other sessions.
candidate: Acceleration in the first-published UK services annual inflation rate in percentage points (current minus preceding first-published annual rate), conditional on the concurrent acceleration in all-items annual inflation. A positive services acceleration is expected to reduce the probability that TLT closes above its open. Slope on unnegated services acceleration must be negative.
control: Separable baseline uses only the similarly computed UK all-items annual inflation acceleration. Additional baselines are training prevalence and a fixed 0.5.
outcome: Regular 09:30 to 16:00 New York open-to-close, raw and split-only Kibot research series sampled only for the preselected dates, direction sign must agree; a flat return is zero. No held-over dividend. Future market prices and public holdout reservations remain sealed. Report overlap with known earlier TLT studies and treat this study as retrospective.
analysis: Seal all feature dates, clocks, version hashes, covariates and the selected civil-calendar hashes before price access. At least 120 paired historical dates, at least 50 training and 20 validation and 20 test; both classes in training, validation and test. Use the existing chronological purged 60/20/20 planner, logistic fitting and validation-only penalty selection, binary Brier loss. Require negative services coefficient and >0.01 held-out error improvement over each of three baselines. Report a 95% paired length-three moving-block interval versus the headline-only model. No other instrument, direction, horizon or feature may substitute following label access. Historical results alone cannot promote a vote. If the source/dates precondition fails, stop before opening outcomes and keep the qualified source in the weekday pipeline.
rights: Attribute Office for National Statistics. Crown copyright, Open Government Licence v3. Retain native vintages and price rows privately; only aggregate research results and the dated ONS measurements are candidates for public use.
